value.rationale: The natural solvable-allocation space for a classical incidence graph has a sharp 2-pebble slack connectivity threshold. At total seven, a capacity-two invariant prevents even arbitrary unit jumps from connecting the space, while local slides divide its 2,576 bounded configurations into 49 islands. One additional pebble joins the 71,323 states. These exact thresholds and state counts describe meaningful optimization mobility not implied by a scalar pebbling number.
